title: Regional population by age and sex, 2024
reliability_authority: Primary national statistical source; SA2 estimates available as XLSX and geospatial web service
notes: Retained for demographic structure; not the preferred current total-population baseline.

title: Regional population, 2024-25
notes: Preferred current regional-population baseline. Includes SA2-and-above ERP 2001-2025, 2024-25 change/components, 1 km population grid and geospatial web services.

title: SA2 Regional Population 2025 Feature Service
reliability_authority: Primary ABS hosted feature layer; geometry and attributes in one service; ASGS Edition 3
notes: Contains SA2 codes/names, SA3/SA4/GCCSA hierarchy, ERP 2001-2025, 2024-25 change, area, density and migration components. Preferred first EXP-001 SA2 spatial source because values and polygons share one geography version.

title: Australian population grid 2025
reliability_authority: Primary ABS 1 km population grid; GeoTIFF download available from Regional population release
notes: Use as fine-grained density representation alongside SA2 ERP. Grid is a derived spatial representation of ERP, not address-level population truth.

title: ASGS Edition 4 digital boundary files
reliability_authority: Primary national geography standard; latest ASGS boundaries
notes: Do not transfer 2025 ERP to Edition 4 boundaries without explicit concordance. EXP-001 first population layer remains native to ASGS Edition 3.

title: 2025 Infrastructure Market Capacity Report
reliability_authority: Primary national infrastructure pipeline analysis based on jurisdictional project data
dollar_basis: AUD; five-year Major Public Infrastructure Pipeline; nominal/price basis not captured here
notes: Useful for regional capital-demand context, not a settlement suitability proxy.

title: Australian Infrastructure and Transport Statistics—Yearbook 2025
notes: Covers freight, passengers, roads, rail, aviation, shipping, infrastructure construction and economy.

title: National Freight Data Hub
reliability_authority: Primary government freight data platform; some products combine operator and government data
notes: Includes freight-train maps, traffic counts, road condition/expenditure, congestion and freight performance.

title: Cross River Rail FAQs and current project status
reliability_authority: Primary project authority; current cost and opening date
dollar_basis: AUD; total cost to complete and associated works as announced Oct 2025
notes: First passenger services expected 2029; major construction progressively through 2027.

title: Logan and Gold Coast Faster Rail
publisher: Queensland Department of Transport and Main Roads
notes: Site establishment/rail works active in 2026; major construction scheduled to ramp up later 2026.

title: The Wave — Stages 1 and 2
publisher: Queensland Department of Transport and Main Roads
dollar_basis: AUD; committed funding for Stage 1 Beerwah–Caloundra
notes: Stage 1 is a 19 km rail extension; Stage 2/3 planning continues separately and should not be treated as included construction commitment.

title: Coomera Connector Stage 1
publisher: Queensland Department of Transport and Main Roads
notes: Stage 1 North opened Dec 2025; Central and South packages under construction.

title: Inland Rail project progress
publisher: Inland Rail / Australian Rail Track Corporation
geographic_coverage: Victoria and New South Wales; corridor north of Parkes preserved for future delivery
notes: Parkes–Narromine and Narrabri–North Star Phase 1 complete; Beveridge–Parkes delivery prioritised.

title: Metro West contracts open next phase of major works
reliability_authority: Primary state government source for signed delivery packages
dollar_basis: AUD; combined value of four contracts, not total project cost
notes: Do not treat $11.5b as total Metro West cost.

title: Western Harbour Tunnel 2026-27 Infrastructure Statement
dollar_basis: AUD; estimated total cost shown in 2026-27 Infrastructure Statement
notes: 6.5 km twin motorway tunnel; current TBM excavation under Sydney Harbour.

title: Coffs Harbour bypass milestones
notes: 14 km bypass; part of continuous motorway-link completion between Sydney and Brisbane.

title: M1 Pacific Motorway extension to Raymond Terrace / Hexham program
dollar_basis: AUD; reported Australian $1.79b plus NSW $448m commitment for M1 extension and Hexham Straight widening program
notes: Hexham widening opened Feb 2026; wider M1 extension expected to open in 2026.

title: Central-West Orana REZ Transmission Project
notes: Construction began June 2025; energisation targeted from 2028.

title: Renewable energy zone locations
notes: NSW has five declared REZs: Central-West Orana, New England, Hunter-Central Coast, Illawarra and South West.

title: HumeLink project
dollar_basis: AUD; FID project value reported Dec 2024
notes: 365 km 500 kV line; main construction in progress.

title: Metro Tunnel project overview and FAQ
dollar_basis: AUD; project cost reported by Victoria's Big Build
notes: Opened 30 Nov 2025; five new underground stations and twin 9 km tunnels.

title: North East Link construction
notes: Tunnel excavation completed July 2026; program scheduled to open in 2028.

title: 2025 Victorian Transmission Plan
notes: Identifies six proposed Victorian REZs; proposed does not equal committed.

title: Queensland Renewable Energy Zone Roadmap
reliability_authority: Primary historical policy source; current status must be checked against later legislation
notes: Identified 12 potential REZ locations; retain as historical/planning evidence only.

title: Energy Roadmap Amendment Act 2025
notes: Amended parts of the earlier REZ framework and terminology toward regional energy hubs; prevents treating older REZ roadmap labels as timeless current status.
